description: Golden evaluation set for search pipeline SOTA validation. 100 hand-curated queries from real agentic memory use cases.

memories.content: Docker containers package applications with their dependencies into portable units that run consistently across environments. Use docker build to create an image, then docker run to launch a container instance.
Python pytest enables test-driven development with fixtures, parametrize decorators, and assertion rewriting. Use conftest.py for shared fixtures across test modules.
Git branching workflows enable team collaboration via trunk-based or feature-branch models. Use pull requests for branch review and merge.
Database indexes accelerate query performance by maintaining sorted lookup trees. Create indexes on frequently filtered columns to avoid full table scans.
REST API design principles emphasize consistent resource naming, proper HTTP status codes, and versioned endpoints for backward compatibility.
Structured logging enables observability by emitting machine-parseable JSON records. Include request IDs and severity levels for effective debugging.
Microservices communicate via asynchronous message queues or REST calls. Use circuit breakers and retries to handle partial failures gracefully.
TCP/IP protocols govern network communication. The transport layer handles reliable delivery via TCP while the network layer routes packets via IP.
Kubernetes orchestrates container deployments at scale using pods, services, and deployments. It manages rolling updates, health checks, and self-healing.
CI pipelines automate testing and deployment. Configure CI workflows to run tests on each push and deploy on merge to main.
Redis provides in-memory caching for session storage, rate limiting, and real-time leaderboards. Use EXPIRE for TTL-based cache invalidation.
GraphQL schemas define a type-safe contract between client and server. Use queries for reads, mutations for writes, and subscriptions for real-time updates.
Docker networking enables container-to-container communication via bridge networks. Use docker network create for custom networks with DNS resolution.
Python asyncio enables concurrent I/O operations using coroutines. Use async/await syntax with asyncio.gather for parallel execution.
PostgreSQL transactions ensure ACID compliance. Use BEGIN, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK for explicit transaction control with isolation levels.
Architecture decision: we chose a vector database for semantic memory retrieval to support approximate nearest neighbor search at scale.
Architecture decision: we adopted the saga orchestration pattern for multi-step write transactions to ensure crash-consistent rollback.
Deployment decision: we decided to containerize all services using Docker for reproducible deployments across environments.
Python serialization decision: we standardised on JSON for memory serialization to ensure cross-language compatibility.
Database decision: we selected PostgreSQL over MySQL for its JSONB support, CTEs, and advanced indexing capabilities.
Infrastructure decision: we adopted Terraform for infrastructure-as-code to manage cloud resources declaratively across providers.
Observability decision: we chose Prometheus + Grafana for metrics collection and visualization, with AlertManager for alerting.
Project: build a local-first semantic memory system for AI agents with FTS5, vector search, and knowledge graph integration.
Project: optimise search pipeline with hybrid RRF fusion, cross-encoder reranking, and temporal decay for sub-200ms latency.
Project: build knowledge graph reasoning using entailment chains with transitive inference and contradiction detection.
Project: implement REST API server for memory CRUD operations with authentication, rate limiting, and WebSocket support.
Project: build evaluation harness for search quality measurement with recall@k, MRR, and latency tracking.
Project: implement cron job system for background maintenance tasks including indexing, compaction, and model retraining.
Project: implement multi-agent memory sharing with CRDT-based conflict resolution and namespace isolation.
Redis Pub/Sub enables real-time messaging between services. Use SUBSCRIBE for channels and PUBLISH for broadcasting events.
Python type hints improve code clarity and enable static analysis with mypy. Use Union for optional types and Protocol for structural subtyping.
SQL optimization techniques include query planning, index selection, and avoiding N+1 queries. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to profile query execution.
Architecture decision: we adopted event-driven architecture with Apache Kafka for decoupled service communication and event sourcing.
Infrastructure decision: we chose Terraform over Pulumi for its mature provider ecosystem and declarative configuration language.
API decision: we use URL-based versioning (/v1/, /v2/) for backward compatibility with automatic deprecation warnings.
Project: automate deployments with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Kubernetes. Zero-downtime rolling updates with health checks.
Project: build Grafana dashboards for system health, search latency, error rates, and resource utilization metrics.
Project: build ETL pipeline for ingesting, transforming, and loading data from multiple sources into the memory database.
WebSocket connections enable bidirectional real-time communication between client and server for live updates and notifications.
Python decorators modify function behavior using @syntax. Common patterns include @lru_cache for memoization and @retry for resilience.
Container security best practices: use non-root users, scan images for vulnerabilities, and implement network policies.
Caching decision: we chose Redis over Memcached for its data structure support, persistence options, and pub/sub capabilities.
Logging decision: we adopted structlog for structured logging with context binding and processor pipelines.
Project: conduct security audit covering OWASP top 10, dependency vulnerabilities, and access control review.
SQL joins combine rows from multiple tables. INNER JOIN returns matching rows, LEFT JOIN includes all from left table, and CROSS JOIN produces cartesian product.
Python context managers use with-statement for resource management. Implement __enter__ and __exit__ or use contextlib.contextmanager decorator.
Docker volumes persist data beyond container lifecycle. Use named volumes for managed storage and bind mounts for development.
Registry decision: we use GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io) for storing Docker images with automated builds on push.
Backup decision: we implement daily automated PostgreSQL backups with 30-day retention and point-in-time recovery capability.
Project: optimize application performance with profiling, caching, query optimization, and connection pooling.
Python generators use yield to produce values lazily. Generator expressions provide memory-efficient iteration over large datasets.
Kubernetes services provide stable network endpoints for pods. Use ClusterIP for internal, NodePort for external, and LoadBalancer for cloud providers.
CI/CD decision: we chose GitHub Actions for its native GitHub integration, marketplace actions, and free tier for open source.
Secrets decision: we use GitHub Secrets for CI/CD and HashiCorp Vault for runtime secrets with automatic rotation.
Project: establish code review process with mandatory PR reviews, automated linting, and security scanning.
Python metaclasses control class creation. Use __new__ for instance creation and __init__ for initialization at the class level.
Docker Compose defines multi-container applications with docker-compose.yml. Use depends_on for startup ordering and volumes for persistence.
Messaging decision: we chose RabbitMQ over Kafka for simpler deployment and better suitability for task queue workloads.
Load balancing decision: we use NGINX as reverse proxy with round-robin distribution and health checks for backend services.
Project: generate OpenAPI 3.0 documentation from code annotations with interactive Swagger UI for API exploration.
Python dataclasses reduce boilerplate for data containers. Use @dataclass decorator with field() for default values and metadata.
Kubernetes ingress manages external HTTP access to services. Configure TLS termination, path-based routing, and rate limiting.
Alerting decision: we configure PagerDuty integration with escalation policies for critical alerts and Slack for warnings.
Project: implement disaster recovery with multi-region deployment, automated failover, and RPO/RTO targets of 1 hour.
Python regex with re module provides pattern matching for text processing. Use raw strings r'' for regex patterns to avoid escape issues.
Docker security scanning with Trivy or Snyk detects vulnerabilities in container images. Integrate into CI pipeline for automated checks.
Caching strategy: we use write-through caching for consistency and cache-aside for read-heavy workloads with TTL-based invalidation.
Project: optimize cloud costs with reserved instances, spot fleets, and auto-scaling policies based on utilization metrics.
Python async patterns: use asyncio.gather for parallel, asyncio.Queue for producer-consumer, and asyncio.Semaphore for concurrency limits.
Kubernetes ConfigMaps store non-sensitive configuration data. Mount as volumes or environment variables for application configuration.
Migration decision: we use Alembic for database schema migrations with automatic generation and rollback support.
Project: implement feature flags for gradual rollouts with percentage-based targeting and user segment filtering.
Python 3.10+ pattern matching with match/case provides structural pattern matching for complex conditional logic.
Docker multi-stage builds reduce final image size by copying only necessary artifacts from builder stages.
API gateway decision: we use Kong for rate limiting, authentication, and request transformation at the edge.
Project: conduct WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit with automated testing and manual screen reader verification.
Python type checking with mypy catches type errors at development time. Use strict mode and TypedDict for dictionary schemas.
Helm charts package Kubernetes applications with templated manifests. Use values.yaml for configuration and Chart.yaml for metadata.
Code quality decision: we enforce ruff for linting, pyright for type checking, and bandit for security analysis in CI.
Project: implement sliding window rate limiting with Redis for distributed enforcement across multiple API server instances.
Python error handling uses try/except/finally with specific exception types. Use custom exceptions for domain-specific error cases.
Docker HEALTHCHECK instruction monitors container health. Configure interval, timeout, and retries for automatic restart on failure.
Error tracking decision: we use Sentry for real-time error aggregation with release tracking and user context.
Project: implement ELK stack for centralized log aggregation, search, and visualization across microservices.
Python unit testing with pytest uses fixtures for setup, parametrize for data-driven tests, and marks for test categorization.
Kubernetes RBAC controls access to cluster resources. Define Roles, ClusterRoles, RoleBindings, and ClusterRoleBindings for fine-grained permissions.
Indexing decision: we use composite indexes for multi-column queries and partial indexes for filtered queries to optimize performance.
Project: implement integration testing with testcontainers for database and Redis, and httpx for API endpoint testing.
Python encoding: use UTF-8 by default, encode/decode explicitly for bytes, and handle BOM for cross-platform file compatibility.
Docker resource limits prevent container resource exhaustion. Set CPU and memory limits in docker-compose or Kubernetes resource quotas.
Orchestration decision: we chose Kubernetes over Docker Swarm for its larger ecosystem, better scaling, and cloud provider support.
Project: automate dependency updates with Dependabot for security patches and Renovate for version upgrades with CI validation.
Python imports use absolute or relative paths. Use __all__ to define public API and __init__.py for package structure.
Kubernetes PersistentVolumes provide durable storage. Use PersistentVolumeClaims for dynamic provisioning with StorageClasses.
Formatting decision: we use black for auto-formatting and isort for import sorting to maintain consistent code style.
Project: implement performance profiling with cProfile, py-spy for sampling, and memory_profiler for memory leak detection.
Python serialization: json for text, pickle for binary, dataclasses.asdict for dataclass conversion, and pydantic for validation.
Docker cleanup: use docker system prune to remove unused containers, images, and networks. Schedule regular cleanup in CI.
Cloud decision: we chose AWS for its mature ecosystem, extensive services, and compliance certifications for our use case.
Project: implement automated documentation generation with Sphinx for Python and TypeDoc for TypeScript APIs.
Python concurrency: threading for I/O-bound, multiprocessing for CPU-bound, and asyncio for event-driven concurrent operations.
Kubernetes networking: pods get IP addresses, Services provide stable endpoints, and NetworkPolicies control traffic flow.
Version control decision: we use conventional commits for automated changelog generation and semantic versioning for releases.
Project: establish on-call rotation with PagerDuty integration, runbook documentation, and post-incident review process.
Python memoization with functools.lru_cache caches function results. Use maxsize parameter and typed=True for type-aware caching.
Docker debugging: use docker exec for interactive shells, docker logs for output, and docker inspect for container metadata.
Testing decision: we follow testing pyramid with unit tests at base, integration tests in middle, and E2E tests at top.
Project: implement chaos engineering with Litmus for controlled failure injection and resilience testing in staging.
Python generics with TypeVar enable type-safe container classes. Use Protocol for structural subtyping and TypeVar for bounded types.
Kubernetes monitoring: use Prometheus for metrics collection, Grafana for visualization, and kube-state-metrics for cluster state.
API security decision: we implement OAuth 2.0 with JWT tokens, rate limiting, and input validation for all endpoints.
Project: establish incident response process with severity levels, escalation procedures, and blameless post-mortems.
